info.title: swarmy API
info.description:
Public, versioned REST API for swarmy. Authenticate with an org-scoped API key: `Authorization: Bearer swk_…`.

`/api/v1` only grows: fields and operations are added, never removed or repurposed, and enums are open (new values may appear). A breaking change ships as a new version; the v1 operation it replaces is marked `deprecated: true` with `x-swarmy-deprecated: { since, sunset, successor?, link? }`, and every response it sends carries `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594) headers, plus a `Link` to its successor, until it is removed after the sunset date.

bearerApiKey.description: swarmy API key (`Authorization: Bearer swk_…`), or an OAuth access token swarmy issued for its APIs (scopes `swarmy:read` / `swarmy:write`). Key scopes: `read` (every GET), `deploy` (ship and roll back: deploy stacks/services, change env, scale, restart, promote, preview), `write` (every mutation; implies `deploy`), `secrets.read` (reveal secret values). A key limited to some apps (`stack_names`) reaches only those apps; org-wide endpoints answer 403 and other apps 404.

invalid_params.description: On a validation 400: every refused field and why (RFC 9457 §3). A write validated as a whole lists each field, not just the first.

last_error.description: The most recent task error Swarm reported (why it is failing); detail responses only.

deploy_id.description: A traced deploy: its step-by-step events at GET /deploys/{id}/events (30 min).

rule.description: The rule that refused it: a guardrail (`no-latest-tag-in-prod`), an exposure or image-policy rule, or the platform wall (`network.control-plane`, `label.system`). Open set.

severity.description: `block` needs an admin/owner override in the dashboard; `warn` needs a confirmation there. The API never overrides.

resource.description: The service (or cluster) it is about.

invalid_params.description: On a validation 400: every refused field and why (RFC 9457 §3). A write validated as a whole lists each field, not just the first.

secret.description: A secret variable, stored as a Docker secret rather than in the service spec. Write-only: an empty `value` keeps the current secret, a non-empty one rotates it.

delivery.description: How a secret reaches the process: `env` (default) or `file` (`<KEY>_FILE` points at it).

ServiceResourceSide.description: One side of the resources. A key left out is cleared; `{}` clears the side.

ServiceResources.description: CPU/memory per copy. A side left out keeps its live value.

ServiceRestartPolicy.description: What Swarm does when a copy exits, merged over the live policy.

command.description: Override argv. `[]` goes back to the image default.

env.description: The plain variables, as a whole: a plain key left out is removed. Secret variables not named here are kept (remove one with `remove_secret_keys`); a secret key sent as plain becomes plain. To change a few keys and keep the rest, use PATCH /services/{id}/env.

update_order.description: During a deploy: start the new copy first, or stop the old one first.

set_labels.description: Service labels to set, merged over the live set.

remove_labels.description: Service labels to remove (before `set_labels` is merged). swarmy’s own `swarmy.managed` and the stack label are kept.

delete_data.description: Whether the app's data (named volumes + its blueprint's generated secrets) was deleted too.

volumes_deleted.description: Named volumes deleted on every server.

volumes_kept.description: Named volumes left on the servers (all of them unless delete_data; else any that could not be removed).

StackEndpointScope.description: Who can resolve the name: services of this app (`app`), of a connected app (`connected`), or the app services attached to a managed resource (`attached`). Open enum: new values may be added.

port.description: The port to pair with it — set when the service has exactly one known port.

reachable_from.description: For `connected`: the peer apps that can use this name. Empty for `app`.

ports.description: Container ports swarmy knows about (routes + published targets).

kind.description: Open enum: new kinds may be added.

name.description: The resource: cluster, instance or bucket name.

attached.description: This app's services wired to it — they alone share its network.

connected_apps.description: Apps (stack names) this one is connected to.

network.description: The private overlay for exactly this pair (`swarmy-link-<hash>`).

services.description: Services this call rolled onto (or off) the pair network; empty when nothing changed.

peer.description: The app to connect to: its stack id or name.

IngressWwwMode.description: Apex ↔ www pairing for the host: serve the apex and 308 www onto it, serve www and 308 the apex onto it, or serve both.

id.description: Catalogue id (`cloudflare`, `quad9`, …), `system`, `swarmy-dns`, or a custom resolver host.

city.description: The operator’s home city. Public resolvers are anycast: this is not where the answer came from.

anchor.description: 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8 — must be among the agreeing resolvers when configured.

state.description: `agrees` points at your edges; `cached` still returns another (usually old) answer and does not block; `no_answer`/`error` are left out of the count.

DomainDnsGate.description: The go-live gate: at least 3 of every 4 public resolvers that answered point at your edges, with 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 (when configured) among them. With no public answer, the controller’s own resolver and swarmy-dns decide (`basis: local`).

reason.description: One plain-words sentence explaining the state.

gated.description: Withheld from the edge until DNS points at swarmy — no certificate is requested meanwhile.

id.description: `<serviceId>:<host>` (+ `/<path>` for a path route). URL-encode it in paths.

label.description: What most registrar UIs want in the host box (`@`, `www`, `app`).

IngressDriver.description: `caddy` swarmy runs Caddy on 80/443; `cloudflared` a Cloudflare Tunnel (no public IP); `none` you run your own proxy. Open enum: new values may be added.

IngressTopology.description: `controller` one replicated Caddy; `edge-per-node` a host-mode Caddy on every ingress node (needs an ingress-labelled node and swarmy object storage). Switching removes and recreates the edge service (seconds of downtime). Open enum.

on_demand.description: Certificates are issued on demand for customer domains.

ask_url.description: The endpoint Caddy asks before issuing on demand.

run_token_set.description: A run token is stored (encrypted). It is never returned.

IngressTunnel.description: The Cloudflare tunnel, or null when none is connected.

api_token_set.description: The token is in a Docker secret. It is never returned.

IngressDnsProvider.description: BYO DNS provider for wildcard certificates in zones swarmy DNS does not serve, or null.

IngressGeoipMode.description: `bundled` the DB-IP Country Lite copy in swarmy’s Caddy build (IP Geolocation by DB-IP, CC BY 4.0); `file` an mmdb already inside the edge container; `off` country rules are saved but not enforced. Open enum.

path.description: The mmdb path inside the edge container (`file` only).

IngressGeoip.description: The country database the edge’s country allow/deny rules read.

target_nodes.description: Node ids the replicated controller is pinned to (empty = no pin).

auto_address_base.description: The workspace’s wildcard-IP base for automatic addresses (e.g. `nip.io`); null = the controller default (sslip.io unless set).

IngressTlsInput.description: On-demand TLS needs an ACME email or an ask endpoint (after the change).

run_token.description: Cloudflare tunnel run token (write-only, encrypted at rest; the tunnel id is read from it). Required to connect.

api_token.description: Provider API token (Zone:DNS:Edit). Write-only: stored only in a Docker secret.

path.description: Required for `file`: an absolute path to a `.mmdb` inside the edge container.

allOf.description: The current topology is a no-op (nothing is recreated).

auto_address_base.description: A wildcard-IP DNS service (`<x>.<a-b-c-d>.<base>` must resolve to a.b.c.d); `null` or empty clears it. Automatic addresses move on the next domain check.

UpdateIngressSettingsRequest.description: Fields left out keep their current value; `null` clears a nullable one. Validated as a whole before anything changes; the edge then converges once.

ApiKeyScope.description: `read` every GET; `deploy` ship and roll back (deploy, env, scale, restart, promote, preview; implies read); `write` every mutation (implies deploy); `secrets.read` reveal secret values. Open enum: new values may be added.

preset.description: The dashboard preset the scopes match (Read-only / Deploy / Admin), or `custom`.

stack_names.description: Apps (stack names) the key may reach; null = every app in the org.

preset.description: Read-only = [read]; Deploy = [read, deploy]; Admin = [read, write, secrets.read]. Wins over `scopes`.

stack_names.description: Limit the key to these apps (stack names). Omit or null for every app.

expiry.description: When the key stops working. Default `never`.

profile.description: The label bundle a node enrolls with (null = the default profile). Open enum: new values may be added.

token_prefix.description: Tells tokens apart; the token itself is never returned again.

setup_key.description: One-use mesh setup key the node joins the mesh with before it registers.

JoinTokenMesh.description: Set when the org runs a mesh: the node joins it with this key first, so the token is single-use.

url.description: The controller base URL the install one-liner should use.

loopback.description: The URL points at loopback, so remote nodes cannot reach it (set CONTROLLER_PUBLIC_URL on the controller).

token.description: Plaintext `swt_…` join token. Only its hash is stored; it is never returned again.

profile.description: The label bundle a node enrolls with (null = the default profile). Open enum: new values may be added.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds; default 3600, at most 7 days.

max_uses.description: How many nodes may join with it; default 1. Forced to 1 while the org runs a mesh.

GitConnectionKind.description: Git provider kind. Open enum — new kinds may be added.

account.description: Provider account the credential acts as, when known.

status.description: `active` or `pending` (an OAuth grant not yet completed).

mode.description: GitLab only. `token` (default) — only mode available over REST; `oauth` needs a browser and is refused.

base_url.description: Provider base URL. Defaults to https://gitlab.com for GitLab; required for gitea/generic.

token.description: Access token. Required for GitLab (≥ 8 chars), optional for gitea/generic. Write-only; never returned.

token_user.description: HTTP basic username the token is sent as (gitea/generic; default `git`).

require_approval.description: GitOps: every planned step waits for confirmation. Set via PUT /apps/{repoId}/require-approval.

enforce_drift.description: GitOps: drift on git-owned fields is re-applied. Set via PUT /apps/{repoId}/enforce-drift.

secret.description: HMAC secret. WRITE-ONCE: returned only by this response.

webhook.description: Webhook to configure on the git host when swarmy could not register it itself (null for GitHub App / auto-registered GitLab hooks). WRITE-ONCE: never returned again.

deploy_key_public.description: Public deploy key to add to the git host. WRITE-ONCE: never returned again.

repo.description: A picked provider repo. Give exactly one of `repo` or `url`.

url.description: Raw clone URL (generic git). Give exactly one of `repo` or `url`.

config_path.description: Path of the swarmy.yaml to apply (default `swarmy.yaml`).

deploy_key.description: Mint an ed25519 deploy key (SSH remotes). Its public half is returned once.

kept_volumes.description: Removed Postgres clusters whose data is still on disk — delete via POST …/environments/{environment}/purge.

branch.description: Branch of a branch preview (absent for PR previews).

from.description: Environment whose latest backup was copied.

scrub.description: Scrub script/profile applied to the copy.

data.description: Preview with data: a COPY of this environment’s latest backup, destroyed with the preview.

previews.description: Live PR previews (latest plan per PR).

drift.description: The last drift check (refreshed by the controller every ~10 min); null = not checked yet.

AppPlanGate.description: `auto` runs on its own, `confirm` waits for POST /apps/plans/{planId}/confirm, `blocked` cannot run.

trigger.description: push, pr, manual, poll, drift, confirm (open set).

status.description: Plan row status, e.g. planned, needs-confirmation, applying, applied, failed, superseded (open set).

plan_status.description: noop, ready, needs-confirmation, blocked — null when the config did not parse.

markdown.description: The plan as the PR comment renders it.

allOf.description: The plan the deploy recorded (null when nothing was planned).

branch.description: Branch head to plan + apply (default: the production branch).

nodes.description: Online nodes the volumes were removed from.

confirm.description: Must be exactly `<stack>/<resource>` — the typed confirmation.

from.description: Named environment to promote to production.

id.description: API key id, or `oauth:<client_id>` for an OAuth token.

value.description: null = withheld (a secret this call may not read).

secret.description: A secret variable (Docker secret), or a plain value that looks secret.

delivery.description: How a secret variable reaches the process; null for plain.

error.description: Why a requested reveal failed (e.g. no running task).

secrets_readable.description: Whether the principal holds ABAC `secrets.read` on this service.

set.description: Plain variables to add or change.

secrets.description: Secret variables to create or rotate. Stored as Docker secrets; never readable back without `secrets.read`.

ts.description: Unix ms, when Docker stamped the line.

phase.description: converging, complete, failed, rolledback, canceled (open set).

dsn.description: The Sentry-compatible DSN apps send to.

store_enabled.description: Whether the observability store (ClickHouse) is on.

pending_redeploy.description: Opted-in services that need a redeploy to receive SENTRY_DSN.

node.description: The server it happened on (`swarmy` for the controller’s own steps).

done.description: Live, failed, or no longer watched: no more events will come.

AlertSignal.description: What the rule watches. Open enum: new signals may be added.

AlertSelector.description: What the rule is narrowed to. Empty = any subject of the signal.

threshold.description: The signal’s threshold (percent, count, days, … per signal). Null = the signal has none.

for_seconds.description: How long the condition must hold before it fires.

is_default.description: One of the seeded per-signal rules (deleting it opts the org out).

muted_until.description: Muted (records, sends nothing) until then; null = not muted.

threshold.description: The signal’s threshold (percent, count, days, … per signal). Null = the signal has none.
The signal’s threshold (percent, count, days, … per signal). Null = the signal has none.

UpdateAlertRuleRequest.description: Fields left out keep their value; the signal never changes.

NotificationChannelKind.description: Where the channel delivers. Open enum: new kinds may be added.

target.description: Redacted destination (an email address or a host). Never a secret.

has_secret.description: A signing secret or token is stored (webhook secret, ntfy/gotify/telegram token).

secret.description: `webhook`: optional HMAC secret (8+ characters); deliveries are signed.

NotificationChannelConfig.description: The destination. Write-only: stored encrypted and never returned.

allOf.description: Replaces the destination (same kind only). Left out keeps it.

GuardrailRuleId.description: A guardrail rule. Open enum: new rules may be added.

severity.description: `block` refuses the deploy (an admin may override in the dashboard); `warn` asks for a confirmation.

params.description: Numeric rule parameters, e.g. `{ "n": 2 }` for minDbReplicasProd.

production_safety_mode.description: On: every rule is enforced at `block` on production stacks.

severity.description: `block` refuses the deploy (an admin may override in the dashboard); `warn` asks for a confirmation.

params.description: Merged into the rule’s params (keys left out keep their value).

GuardrailRuleUpdate.description: Fields left out keep their configured value.

rules.description: Only the rules named change; the rest keep their state.

UpdateGuardrailsRequest.description: Partial: what already holds is not rewritten (and writes no audit row).

effect.description: A matching forbid overrides every permit.

priority.description: Higher decides first (and names the deciding rule).

is_default.description: A seeded default: may be switched off, not rewritten or deleted.

effect.description: A matching forbid overrides every permit.

source.description: The policy document as JSON, e.g. `{"roles":["member"],"actions":["service.restart"]}`. Validated before saving.

priority.description: Default 0 on create; kept on update when left out.

enabled.description: Default true on create; kept on update when left out.

PolicyRequest.description: The whole rule. On update, a description left out is cleared.

summary.description: The post-mortem summary, when someone wrote one.

duration_sec.description: Open: seconds so far. Resolved: the whole span.

kind.description: opened, alert.fired, alert.resolved, db.failover, note, status.<phase>, resolved, reopened, … (open set).

summary.description: The post-mortem summary, when someone wrote one.

duration_sec.description: Open: seconds so far. Resolved: the whole span.

notify.description: Its firing notification went out, is held for quiet hours, was muted, or was skipped.

post.summary: Drain a node (cordon — stop scheduling, move tasks off)
Cordon a node (alias of drain)
Uncordon a node (restore availability `active`)
Create a service (async deploy)

412.description: Admission refused the deploy — guardrails, exposure, image policy or the platform network wall. `violations` lists every rule it broke; over the API any violation refuses (`warn` included), since confirming a warning or overriding a block happens in the dashboard.

patch.description: Changes the fields sent (image, replicas, command, env, resources, restart policy, update order, labels) on the service's full live spec; everything else is kept. Runs the same admission checks as a deploy, so a guardrail can refuse it (412). Policy: `service.configure` on the service. Poll the returned deployment to a terminal phase.

202.description: Accepted — the update is rolling out

412.description: Admission refused the deploy — guardrails, exposure, image policy or the platform network wall. `violations` lists every rule it broke; over the API any violation refuses (`warn` included), since confirming a warning or overriding a block happens in the dashboard.

post.summary: Scale a service (async deploy)
Restart a service (async deploy)
Deploy a stack from a compose document (async)

412.description: Admission refused the deploy — guardrails, exposure, image policy or the platform network wall. `violations` lists every rule it broke; over the API any violation refuses (`warn` included), since confirming a warning or overriding a block happens in the dashboard.

delete.description: Stops and removes every service in the stack. Its data — the named volumes on every server and the secrets its blueprint generated — is KEPT unless `delete_data=true`, so redeploying the same name picks the old data back up. Audited.

schema.description: Also delete the app's data (default false).

get.summary: How to reach an app's services and managed resources from inside the cluster
get.description: The internal DNS names swarm answers for each service (`web` in-app, `shop_web`, `tasks.web`, `web.shop` from a connected app) and the host:port of each managed resource, with who can use each. Read from live Docker state.

post.summary: Connect two apps over one private network
post.description: Creates a private overlay for exactly this pair and rolls every app service of both onto it, aliased `<service>.<app>` — so this app reaches `api.billing:8080`. A third app sees neither; managed databases are not shared. Idempotent: an existing connection is a no-op. Policy: `stack.deploy` on both apps.

delete.description: Every service of both apps leaves the pair network and stops resolving the other. A peer that no longer exists is fine — the remaining side is detached. Policy: `stack.deploy` on both apps.

schema.description: The other app: its stack id or name.

post.summary: Add an ingress domain

get.description: Lifecycle state (waiting_dns → verified → issuing → active | error), the exact DNS records to create, what public DNS answers, and the certificate each edge serves.

post.summary: Re-check a domain now
post.description: Runs the DNS (and, once verified, certificate) check immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

get.description: Driver, topology, image, target nodes, TLS, tunnel, DNS provider, country database and automatic-address base. Secrets read back as set / not set, never their values.

put.description: One write for every edge setting: the body is validated as a whole (nothing changes when any part is refused, and `invalid_params` names each refused field), saved, and the edge converges once. Fields left out keep their current value; `null` clears a nullable one. A topology change removes and recreates the edge service; the current topology is a no-op.

400.description: Refused as a whole: `invalid_params` names every field and why; nothing changed

412.description: A precondition failed (no ingress node, or object storage off, for edge-per-node)

post.summary: Create an API key (plaintext returned once)

201.description: Created — carries the plaintext key (shown once)

get.summary: List join tokens (never the token itself)

post.summary: Create a join token (plaintext returned once)
post.description: Admins and owners only. Pass `token` to the agent installer as `SWARMY_JOIN_TOKEN` on the new server.

201.description: Created — carries the plaintext token (shown once)

delete.description: A revoked token enrolls nothing, and no longer re-adopts a server that joined with it (a reinstall needs a fresh token). Policy: `token.revoke`.

post.summary: Create a DNS zone

get.summary: Check registrar delegation for a zone
get.description: Public NS lookup compared to the advertised nameserver set, plus a direct SOA probe of each glue IP.

get.summary: List manual records in a zone (MX/TXT/CNAME/…)

post.summary: Create or update a manual record (upsert by name+type+value)
Add a backup target (restic repo)
Back up a volume now (creates a snapshot)
Restore a snapshot into a volume
Register + provision a cluster volume

get.summary: Export the org audit log (CSV or JSON, max 10 000 rows)

200.description: The export body. `X-Swarmy-Row-Count` carries the row count; `X-Swarmy-Truncated: true` means the filter matched more than the 10k cap.

post.summary: Send an email through the org’s Email service
post.description: Hands the message to the org’s Email service (direct delivery or the domain’s relay, as set on the Email page). Needs Email turned on with a verified domain.

post.summary: Create a registry credential (or rotate the login for an existing prefix)

patch.summary: Update a registry credential (username/label, or rotate the secret)

post.summary: Test a stored credential (registry v2 auth; manifest HEAD when `image` is given)

get.summary: List git provider connections (credentials never returned)

post.summary: Connect a GitLab (token), Gitea or generic git host
post.description: GitHub App and GitLab OAuth connections need a browser and are refused with `422` (`swarmy_code: BROWSER_FLOW_REQUIRED`) — make those in the dashboard. A GitLab token is verified against the provider before it is saved. Admin/owner only.

get.summary: List repositories the connection can see (the provider's repo picker)
get.description: Generic git hosts have no listing API and return an empty list — link them by URL.

get.summary: List branches of a repository visible to the connection

post.summary: Link a repository (branch + swarmy.yaml path) as an app binding
post.description: Give either a picked provider `repo` (with its `connection_id`) or a raw `url`. The response carries the webhook secret and deploy-key public half ONCE — store them; no read returns them again. Admin/owner only.

patch.summary: Change a linked repository's branch and/or swarmy.yaml path in place
patch.description: Admin/owner only. The next push/poll plans against the new branch/path.

get.summary: List GitOps apps (linked repos) with each environment’s latest plan

post.summary: Confirm held steps of a plan, then apply them
post.description: Each step is authorized by what it destroys (data.destroy / service.remove / stack.deploy); a step the key’s principal may not confirm fails the whole call with `403`. Ids that are not held (or no longer planned) are ignored.

put.summary: Set the app’s require-approval toggle (every step waits for confirmation)

post.summary: Plan and apply the head of a branch now
post.description: Runs the same plan → apply as a push (destructive steps still wait for confirmation). Returns when the plan is recorded and its runnable part applied. Admin/owner only.

get.summary: Compare each environment’s last applied commit with live state (changes nothing)
get.description: An empty list means no drift.

put.summary: Opt in (or out) of re-applying drift on git-owned fields
put.description: Default is report-only. When on, drift is re-applied as a `drift`-triggered plan; destructive steps still wait for confirmation. Admin/owner only.

post.summary: Delete a REMOVED managed Postgres’s data permanently (its volumes on every node)
post.description: Irreversible. Requires `data.destroy` (checked at the route AND per resource in the service) and the typed confirmation `confirm: "<stack>/<resource>"`. Refused (400) while swarmy.yaml still declares the resource, its removal is not yet confirmed, or it is still running.

post.summary: Promote a named environment’s running image digests (e.g. staging) to production
post.description: No rebuild: production is planned with the digests the source environment runs now, through the same gates (destructive steps still wait). Admin/owner only.

get.summary: Who this credential acts as, and what it may do

get.description: Plain variables with their values; secret variables (and plain values that look secret) with `value: null` unless `reveal_secrets=true` AND the key holds the `secrets.read` scope AND policy permits `secrets.read` on the service. Every reveal is audited.

patch.description: Keys not named are kept exactly (secret variables included). `secrets` become Docker secrets (new versions, rolling update). Policy: `service.configure` on the service.

412.description: Admission refused the deploy — guardrails, exposure, image policy or the platform network wall. `violations` lists every rule it broke; over the API any violation refuses (`warn` included), since confirming a warning or overriding a block happens in the dashboard.

get.summary: The last lines of a service’s logs (all tasks)

schema.description: Unix seconds; only lines after this time.

get.description: Each `data:` event is one LogLine as JSON. The stream stays open until the client disconnects.

schema.description: Unix seconds; only lines after this time.

get.summary: A deployment’s convergence (poll until a terminal phase)

post.summary: Preview a branch (trial deploy)
post.description: Plans the branch’s swarmy.yaml and deploys it as a preview environment with its own stack and URL, the same machinery as a branch or pull-request preview. Torn down by `previews.ttl` or when the branch is deleted.

post.summary: Rotate the stack’s DSN key (the old key stops working at once)
